rules: P2 DECISION-AUTHORITY.md §3 A1-A9 with the §5 v0.2 changes C1-C5

decisions.statement: `move <appointment> <date> <time>` replaces only the Date and Time of an existing appointment; its id, patient and clinician stay the same. On success it prints `<appointment> moved to <yyyy-MM-dd> at <HH:mm>` (e.g. `a1 moved to 2026-03-12 at 10:00`).

A move is checked with exactly the rules a new booking is checked with, by calling the same existing functions in `Rules` (no new rule is written): the new date must satisfy `Rules.withinBookingHorizon` against the session's today (DEC-C01), and the new slot must satisfy `Rules.slotFree` for the appointment's clinician (DEC-C02). Refusals use the same ClinicError values and so the same messages as `book` (`appointments can be booked 1 to 90 days ahead`, `<clinician> is already booked on <date> at <time>`), checked in the same order as `book` (horizon, then slot). A refused move leaves the state unchanged.

Read literally, 'a move that a new booking at that date and time would be refused for is refused': moving an appointment to the date and time it already occupies is refused with the slot-taken error, because a new booking at that slot would be refused. No exception is made for the appointment's own slot, since no source gives one.
Moving an appointment id that does not exist is refused with `error: unknown appointment <id>` (existing UnknownAppointment error) and changes nothing.

Parsing and command structure follow `book`: Cli parses the date and time with the existing `Commands.parseDate`/`Commands.parseTime` (so a malformed value gives the existing `error: invalid date <x>` / `error: invalid time <x>`), then calls a new pure `Commands.move today id day at state`, which looks up the appointment, then applies the DEC-W-2 checks. A wrong number of words gives the existing generic `error: usage: move <appointment> <date> <time>` via the usage table. No new Domain types or error cases are added.

`help` (the `usage` list in Cli) lists `move <appointment> <date> <time>` directly after `cancel <appointment>`; all other lines and their order are unchanged. The command list in README.md is updated the same way so the documented command set matches `help`.

Add tests beyond the provided acceptance tests for criteria they do not cover: a refused move (horizon, slot, unknown appointment, invalid date/time) leaves the schedule unchanged; the moved appointment keeps its patient and clinician and frees its old slot; moving to its own current slot is refused (DEC-W-3); wrong arity prints the usage error. Existing tests are not changed.
